title: Explore the historical 2026 program
body: Demo-authored historical note, dated April 1, 2026 for the fixture. It is not an original NC Local post. This past-event demo contains eight selected sessions from March 27, 2026. It does not offer future attendance, registration or email signup. The original published agenda contains the full program.

content.value: NC Local and NC Open Government Coalition co-produced the summit. WUNC participated in the Due South lunch broadcast. The Assembly sponsored the afterparty.
